APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANTS KONSTANTINE PAXINOS AND LEENA RANDHAWA. DEFENDANT LEENA RANDHAWA WAIVES SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. PLAINTIFF REQUESTS TO AMEND PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM FROM $9,000.00 TO $10,000.00 AND TO CORRECT SPELLING OF DEFENDANT LENNA RANDHAWA TO LEENA RANDHAWA. DEFENDANT DOES NOT OBJECT TO THIS ORAL REQUEST IN COURT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED. (506)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-05-2017 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ALFARO, ANABELLA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT PAXINOS, KONSTANTINE RANDHAWA, LEENA . PLAINTIFF'S COMPLAINT IS AMENDED TO REFLECT THE TRUE NAME OF DEFENDANT RANDHAWA AS LEENA RANDHAWA AND AN INCREASE IN PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM FROM $9,000.00 $10,000.00 WHICH IS NOT OBJECTED BY EITHER DEFENDANT.
